description: This Java source file contains JUnit test cases for the PatientSearchCriteria class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing various search parameter parsing, matching modes, and search mode identification logic.

classes.name: PatientSearchCriteriaTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the PatientSearchCriteria class in the OpenMRS API.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by injecting a SessionFactory bean and creating instances of PatientSearchCriteria and GlobalPropertiesTestHelper.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessSimpleSpaceAsSeparator
methods.description: Tests that getQueryParts correctly splits a string with spaces into individual parts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessCommaAsSeparator
methods.description: Tests that getQueryParts correctly splits a comma-separated string into parts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldProcessMixedSeparators
methods.description: Tests handling of mixed separators (commas and spaces) in getQueryParts.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldNotReturnEmptyNameParts
methods.description: Ensures getQueryParts does not return empty strings when input has leading/trailing/multiple spaces.

methods.name: getQueryParts_shouldRejectNullAsName
methods.description: Checks that getQueryParts throws IllegalArgumentException when input is null.

methods.name: isShortName_shouldRecogniseShortName
methods.description: Verifies that isShortName recognizes a single-character name as short.

methods.name: isShortName_shouldRecogniseLongName
methods.description: Verifies that isShortName recognizes longer names as not short.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnStartAsDefaultMatchMode
methods.description: Ensures getMatchMode defaults to MatchMode.START if no global property is set.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnStartAsConfiguredMatchMode
methods.description: Tests that getMatchMode returns the configured match mode after setting the global property to 'START'.

methods.name: getMatchMode_shouldReturnAnywhereAsConfiguredMatchMode
methods.description: Tests that getMatchMode returns the configured match mode 'ANYWHERE' after setting it.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByName
methods.description: Tests that getSearchMode detects searches by name based on various input parameters.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByIdentifier
methods.description: Tests detection of search mode as by identifier.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByIdentifierTypeList
methods.description: Tests detection of search by identifier with a list of identifier types.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByIdentifierAndIdentifierTypeList
methods.description: Tests detection of search mode as by identifier with identifier list.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByNameOrIdentifier
methods.description: Tests detection of search by name or identifier when only one parameter is non-empty.

methods.name: getSearchMode_shouldIdentifySearchByNameAndIdentifier
methods.description: Tests detection of search mode as by both name and identifier.

methods.name: copySearchParameter_shouldReturnSourceValueWhenTargetIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that copying a search parameter returns source when target is blank.

methods.name: copySearchParameter_shouldReturnTargetValueWhenTargetIsNonblank
methods.description: Tests that copying a search parameter returns target when target is non-blank.
